'''Grathus''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Toria" /> located in the [[Grathus system/Legends|Grathus system]], a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet featured several large mud basin settlements, including one which contained a [[Xig Rollem's tavern|tavern]] owned by [[Xig Rollem]].<ref name="Toria" />

At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}} is set at some point following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the shipping destination of one newly built [[Lovolan]] [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-class servant droid]] was accidentally changed due to an error in the manufacturer's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network. The [[Service droid/Legends|servant droid]], [[Threna]], was transported to Grathus, whose inhabitants were instead expecting to receive scorched parts for waste storage.<ref name="Toria" />

Rollem subsequently put the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to work at his [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] serving refreshments. The polite attitude of Threna, who was originally designed for employment at luxurious locales, made the establishment's clientele enjoy her company, with the tavern's previously rowdy patrons becoming more well-behaved as a result.<ref name="Toria" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grathus was introduced in "[[Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)|Toria Tell's Droid Journal]]," an article written by [[Christian Piccolo]] and published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="Toria" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Grathus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
